WITH award_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.throws, '') AS throws_group,
    COUNT(*) AS award_count
  FROM player_award pa
  INNER JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, '')
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total FROM award_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws_group,
    award_count,
    CAST(award_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) AS share
  FROM award_counts
),
avg_share_overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM with_shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    throws_group,
    award_count,
    share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_overall)
)
SELECT
  SUM(award_count) AS total_of_tallies,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_qualifying,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_overall)) AS avg_excess
FROM above_avg
